title: Second Conditional: More Practice — Quiz 80
content:
## Second Conditional: More Practice

Choose past simple and would for imaginary situations.

### Lesson focus

1. If it ___, we would stay at home. (rained / had rained)
2. If I were you I ___ home immediately. (would go / would have gone)
3. He ___ look a lot better if he shaved more often. (will / would)
4. If I ___ wings, I would fly like a bird. (had / had had)

### Understand the pattern

Choose the conditional type from the meaning of the whole sentence. Would in the result clause suggests an imagined present or future condition here. In formal hypothetical advice, if I were you is a standard expression.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. rained
2. would go
3. would
4. had

In 1 and 4, past simple expresses an imaginary condition. In 2, the speaker is giving hypothetical advice now; would have gone would instead refer to an imagined result in the past.

### Try another

Correct: If I would have more time, I would read more.

### Suggested answer

If I had more time, I would read more. In the ordinary second-conditional pattern, would belongs in the result clause rather than before had in the if-clause.
